page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Right edge shows only show-through and the neighbouring page's edge, which are left out.

main_text.p: praecipio vobis, neq; minuetis ex eo. Idem cap. 5.

Non recedetis ad dextram, neque ad finistram, id est, nihil mutabis, aut alterabis. Idem 12[?], cap. Galat.1. Si quis praedicauerit aliud Euan-gelium, &c. Gal.3. Hominis testamentum, si fit comprobatum, nemo reiicit, aut addit aliquid, hoc est, non licet addere. Ita lex Mosis, à Deo tradita, non facit irritum nec alterat Testamentum ante à Deo comprobatum erga Christum. Quanto minus igitur potest aut debet Ecclesia abrogare aut alterare sacram Scripturam, vtrumque Testamentum, antea à Deo editum, scriptum & comprobatum, & sanguine Christi confirmatum?

2. Iubet etiam Dominus, vt in omnibus rebus dubiis, veritas petatur non ab Ecclesia, sine Scripturis, sed è Scripturis ipsis, Ief. 8. ad Legem & ad testimonium. Deut. 13. iubet, ne audiamus Prophetam quempiam qui aliquid diuer-sum à sacra Scriptura doceat, et-iamsi prædicat verè futura, & edat miracula, imò vt ille lapidibus obruatur. Quare?Qui a execratur Dominus eos, qui in sua Scriptura sancta quippiam mutant. Ideo iubet, dicens: Incedite post Dominum Deum vestrum: Deum timete: illius præcepta custodite: illius vocem audite.

Ex iis Scripturarum locis luculenter ap-paret, neque Ecclesiæ, neque vlli hominum licere, quippiam in sacris Literis alterare, mutare, dispensare: sed contrà velle Domi-num, vt omnia ad Scripturas examinentur,

page.notes: Doubtful: "Idem 12" (the numeral looks like an old-style 2 and may be 11). "Deut. 13." and "Ief. 8." are as printed. "Quare?Qui a" has no space in print and may be a spacing fault. "sacram" in the line "sacram Scripturam" is read as sacram; the word is clear. The initial "p" of "paret" is a decorative drop letter, so the word is read as ap-paret. "Non" at the start of the second paragraph has a decorative capital N, read as Non. Show-through and the adjoining page edge at the right are not transcribed.
